feedback_text: Intermittent 504 Gateway Timeouts when syncing customer data warehouse batches over 10k rows.
The in-app review modal crashes immediately on iOS 18 Safari when virtual keyboard layout triggers UIKit recursion.
Exporting quarterly analytics PDF report takes over 78 seconds and frequently terminates with worker OOM kill.
Search input lags terribly when typing queries with more than 50 active items on the board.
WebSocket disconnects silently after 15 minutes of idle time, causing missed real-time status updates.
Memory leak in Chrome tab: RAM usage climbs to 1.8GB after keeping dashboard open for 4 hours.
File upload progress bar freezes at 99% on attachments larger than 25MB even though file completes.
Dark mode CSS toggle causes white flash on page navigation in Firefox 128.
Page load time increased from 1.2s to 2.4s after the latest v2.4 deploy. Still usable but noticeable.
Occasionally have to refresh the browser to see newly assigned team member avatar icons.
The new query caching layer made board view render 3x faster than last month!
Zero downtime during database migration last weekend was deeply appreciated by our DevOps team.
Background batch export completed smoothly without freezing our frontend UI session.
Redis cache invalidation bug: deleted tags continue appearing in board filter dropdowns until cache TTL expires.
Mobile responsive view on iPad Mini cuts off modal action buttons at bottom of viewport.
Slack OAuth webhook integration fails with 401 Unauthorized whenever access token refreshes.
Jira bi-directional sync drops custom field mappings when synchronizing resolved issue statuses.
GitHub PR link unfurling broke after the latest webhook signature validation patch.
Zapier integration triggers duplicate feedback events when webhooks are retried after network blips.
Google Drive export fails silently when folder path contains special characters or slashes.
Webhook payload format changed without version header deprecation notice. Broke our internal parser.
Would like the Figma Code Connect plugin to support custom design token aliases.
The Slack unfurl cards with live status badges look fantastic in our #product channel.
Google Sheets auto-sync integration connects in under 30 seconds with zero setup friction.
Linear bi-directional sync is rock solid. Best implementation we have used across SaaS tools.
Segment event tracking is working well, but missing user tenant ID on custom event payloads.
HubSpot CRM contact sync creates duplicate records if email casing does not match exactly.
Webhook delivery latency is consistently under 120ms to our AWS Lambda endpoints.
REST API rate limiter returns 429 too aggressively during initial team onboarding import batches.
Notion database embed sync fails when Notion workspace has more than 50 shared databases.
iOS app crashes on launch when opening a universal project invite deep-link from Apple Mail.
Android push notifications fail to clear after viewing feedback item in mobile app.
Touch target on iPad close 'X' button is only 16px wide, violating HIG touch accessibility standards.
Offline mode on iOS fails to sync draft feedback notes back to cloud after reconnecting to Wi-Fi.
FaceID login prompt loops continuously if user cancels biometric prompt on iPhone 15 Pro.
Tablet layout simply stretches phone UI instead of taking advantage of dual-column split view.
Dark mode in mobile app does not respect iOS system appearance toggle automatically.
Mobile app feels lightweight and snappy when reviewing daily digest updates during commute.
Push notification grouping for critical bug alerts helped our on-call team catch outages fast.
Android keyboard overlaps bottom submit button on Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra.
Universal deep links on mobile browsers redirect to login page instead of the target feedback board.
Haptic feedback on card dragging in mobile app is a delightful touch.
Biometric unlock works reliably but takes 2 seconds to transition into dashboard.
Audio feedback recording feature cuts off after 30 seconds on iOS without warning message.
Clean font rendering and great contrast on mobile OLED screens.
Our 800-person company security policy strictly mandates Okta/SAML SSO before deploying any SaaS vendor.
Locking SAML/SSO behind a $25k enterprise tier is blocking our departmental deal approval.
Our IT audit failed because Laser AI does not currently provide SCIM automated user provisioning.
We require SOC2 Type II report and ISO 27001 certificate before our procurement team can sign.
Inviting external contractors exposes our entire project space unless folder-level gating is enforced.
Need custom session timeout duration configuration (e.g. 15-minute idle logout for HIPAA compliance).
Would like audit log export to AWS S3 bucket or Datadog for security compliance archiving.
Role-based access controls for Founder vs PM are clean and prevent cross-role data leaks.
Two-factor authentication with TOTP authenticator apps works reliably across our team.
Collaborator can demote project owner permissions due to lack of creator ACL protection.
We need custom data residency options (EU data storage in Frankfurt) to satisfy GDPR requirements.
Security review questionnaire was answered quickly and thoroughly by the enterprise support team.
API tokens do not support granular read-only scopes; tokens grant full workspace admin permissions.
Password complexity requirements should allow admins to enforce 16+ characters with symbols.
End-to-end TLS encryption and modern cipher suites passed our Qualys SSL audit with A+.
Our executive team is reviewing competitor AcmeApp because per-seat pricing increased 40% without grandfathering.
We have 15 external clients who only need view-only access; paying full $30/seat for guests is a dealbreaker.
Procurement rejected annual contract because there is no self-serve option to purchase 5 extra seats mid-cycle.
Billing page lacks transparent breakdown of usage overages and active user seat counts.
We want annual invoicing via ACH or Wire Transfer instead of mandatory corporate credit card billing.
Need non-profit / educational tier discount for our research university product team.
The transparent pricing tier structure without hidden AI token fees is refreshing compared to competitors.
Upgrading from Starter to Growth tier took 10 seconds with instant feature enablement.
Sales rep took 4 days to respond with enterprise custom seat pricing quote.
Credit card failed during renewal and workspace was locked immediately without 7-day grace period.
Free trial gave us full access to test AI digest synthesis on our real customer sheet. Converted us!
Would appreciate quarterly billing option in addition to monthly and annual.
Refund policy is rigid: charged for unused seats after team member offboarding.
Enterprise package included dedicated onboarding manager who set up our Google Sheets integration in 1 hour.
Competitor offers unlimited viewer accounts for free; Laser AI requires paid license for client reviews.
The in-app review prompt triggered during checkout on mobile Safari and cancelled my transaction state!
I downloaded the app 45 seconds ago and was immediately blocked by a full-screen 5-star review modal. Let me use the product!
Close button on review popup modal is tiny and hard to tap on mobile browsers.
Dark mode contrast is too low in Kanban card subtext; grey text on dark slate is unreadable.
Drag and drop between Kanban board columns feels sluggish when dragging across 4+ columns.
The clean light SaaS aesthetic is stunning. Minimal whitespace, crisp slate typography, Notion-like feel.
Love the frosted pastel pill badges for tags—makes scanning issues on the board effortless.
The new sentiment distribution bar chart gives leadership instant visual clarity in 5 seconds.
Would love keyboard shortcuts (e.g. 'c' to create new ticket, 'j/k' to navigate list items).
Kanban card columns should allow custom horizontal scrolling or collapsible side panels.
Dropdown menus close unexpectedly when mouse cursor moves slightly outside bounding box.
Side drawer ticket inspection with live comments feels incredibly fluid and fast.
Breadcrumbs at top of screen are not clickable on mobile portrait mode.
Role isolation switch is smooth: viewing as Founder vs PM instantly adjusts visual clutter.
Font size in data table rows is slightly small on 14-inch laptop screens.
Project invite links expire after 10 minutes and external clients get 403 Forbidden errors.
Admins cannot clearly tell whether a teammate has edit or view-only access on shared boards.
When two PMs edit issue summary simultaneously, last save overwrites without conflict warning.
Team member list has no search filter; finding a specific contributor in a 50-person team is slow.
Sharing filtered feedback views directly into Slack channels keeps cross-functional teams in sync.
The daily role-tailored digest delivered to our team Slack channel eliminated our Monday status meeting!
Need @mention autocomplete notifications inside ticket comment threads.
Assignee avatars and initials on cards make it obvious who owns each feedback initiative.
Cannot transfer project ownership when a workspace admin leaves the company.
Would like public read-only link sharing with password protection.
Collaborative comment feed with Slack bot integration makes bug triage enjoyable.
Slack unfurl cards do not update in real-time when ticket priority changes from High to Resolved.
Role-based digest ensures our engineers never get spammed with sales pricing feedback.
Allow grouping workspace members into teams (e.g. @frontend-team, @core-engineers).
Exporting board summary to Markdown for our weekly Notion documentation is very handy.
First-time setup was confusing because sample Google Sheet took 3 minutes to auto-populate.
Onboarding form did not explain difference between PM and Engineer digest scopes clearly.
Connecting Google Sheet via direct CSV link worked on the first try without API keys.
Interactive Onboarding flow with role dropdown (Founder, PMs, Engineers, Sales) is super clean.
Would be helpful to have a 60-second video walkthrough modal on the welcome screen.
Demo workspace pre-loaded with realistic customer feedback allowed us to evaluate AI in minutes.
Invited team members did not receive welcome email with login instructions on first invite.
Clean, dedicated full-page sign-up screen without modal clutter felt very professional.
Allow uploading sample CSV directly from local disk instead of requiring Google Sheet URL.
Error message when entering an invalid Google Sheet link was too vague ('Fetch Failed').
Setting digest notification frequency to Daily or Weekly with one click was dead simple.
Default empty input fields with clean placeholders made sign up fast and straightforward.
Interactive tour tooltips should be dismissible with Escape key.
Great onboarding checklist that guided us through connecting Slack webhook in 2 minutes.
Safari autofill populated full name incorrectly in email notification field.
PDF export format cuts off table columns on right margin when printing in portrait mode.
CSV export does not include role_relevance scores or sentiment confidence ratings.
Weekly email digest delivery arrived 4 hours late last Monday due to batch queue backlog.
The rendered HTML email digest looks gorgeous on mobile Gmail and desktop Outlook.
Slack Block Kit formatted digest cards are interactive and allow one-click ticket opening.
Would love scheduled automated CSV export to Google Cloud Storage or Amazon S3.
Add custom company logo branding option to exported PDF customer intelligence reports.
Sentiment trajectory graph (+12% positive trend vs last week) is great for executive decks.
Executive summary text in email digest was truncated after 300 characters on mobile email client.
Export to Google Sheets preserves column formatting and UTF-8 quotation marks cleanly.
Date range filter in reporting tab only allows last 7 days or last 30 days; cannot pick custom calendar range.
Actionable checklist at the bottom of the digest gives our PM team immediate sprint items.
Would be great to export charts as transparent SVG vector files for slide decks.
One-click 'Dispatch Instant Digest' button verified live email and Slack integration instantly.
Chart legends in PDF exports render with blurry low-resolution bitmap fonts.
Slack bot posts duplicate digest cards if webhook endpoint encounters temporary network retry.
No option to configure digest notification time zone; digests arrive at 3 AM local Tokyo time.
Critical urgency bug alerts ping our Slack channel within 1 minute of customer submission.
Clean Slack Block Kit formatting with color-coded severity badges makes triage instant.
Would like Microsoft Teams webhook integration in addition to Slack.
Email digest notification emails were marked as spam by Microsoft Defender for Office 365.
Allow setting digest frequency to 'Bi-Weekly' or 'Monthly' for executive board members.
Ability to test Slack webhook directly from onboarding screen saved us tons of debug time.
Notification bell icon in app header does not show unread badge count.
Email subject lines are clear and concise (e.g. 'Laser AI Daily Digest: 3 Critical Bugs Found').
Would appreciate Discord webhook support for our gaming developer community feedback channel.
Unsubscribe link in footer works instantly without forcing password login.
Push notifications on macOS Safari do not play subtle alert sound.
Digest summary email groups similar bugs under recurring themes, eliminating redundant alerts.
Provide preview button in settings to send a test digest email before activating live schedule.
